csv_project_name: AE Services for Olympia Readiness Center Addition
csv_agency: State of Michigan Dept of Management & Budget
csv_scope_of_work: The Department of Technology, Management and Budget (DTMB) on behalf of Michigan Department of Military and Veterans Affairs (DMVA), Michigan Army National Guard (MIARNG), is requesting professional architectural and engineering services to perform Phase 300-700 Professional Services for design and construction oversite at the subject project at Olympia Readiness Center, Detroit, Michigan. The intent of this selection process is to contract with a qualified firm to provide ad-hoc professional services to prepare construction drawings, bid documents, and construction oversite to design facility improvements and a 3- story expansion to the Detroit Olympia Readiness Center that supports individual and collective training, administration, communication, and logistics. The building currently serves 3 national guard units and the readiness center is being expanded to serve 4 units. The full scope of the project is discovered through a design charrette held at the readiness center (armory).
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Landscape Architecture, Rehabilitation & Refurbishment, Civil Engineering, Cost Estimating, Electrical Engineering, Fire Protection Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Structural Engineering, Utility Engineering, Stormwater
